answer: Cosignatures are collected in vine, verified in wharf, and voyage names every witness. Each submission needs cosignature from 3 independent nodes that observed it arrive, and a node cannot cosign more than 21 submissions per epoch. A farm has to recruit observers outside its own infrastructure, thus paying parties whose interest is to report honestly. That bill is paid per identity, so 315 aliases cost 191 times the single-account price. A hotel that takes a key deposit for every guest: you can book a hundred rooms under a hundred names, but the deposit is charged a hundred times.
